title: 第180章 她习惯性依赖他~
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这位女士！您不能进来！”

后面的服务人员三两步上前，急忙走到孟晚身边，拦下了她。

少女站在众人之间，被无数服务人员簇拥着，如同众星拱月一般。

真皮沙发上，男人气质清冷矜贵，一身深灰色的西装贵气沉稳，他端正地坐在那里，目光只是落在面前的少女身上。

少女提起裙摆，吊带的裙子露出漂亮白皙的锁骨。

她的头发是低盘发，有几缕发丝环绕，垂落在她的肩头，笑起来乖巧又温软。

她分明看到她了。

眼中带着不加掩饰的挑衅，看向孟晚时微微歪头，唇角勾起一抹弧度。

孟晚眼眶瞪大，一脸愤恨：“宋瓷！！”

像是被突如其来的声音吓到一般，那原本挑衅的眼神瞬间转换为慌乱无措。

慌张地往祝砚铮身边挪动几步，少女下意识地去抓男人的衣袖。

孟晚见状，脸色难看得厉害，声音尖锐：“宋瓷！你到底是什么意思！？”

起初祝砚铮的目光都放在宋瓷身上。

听到身后的声音，男人微微蹙眉。

少女抓着他的衣袖，他便微微用力，将她整个人拉到了自己身旁，圈占在了他的安全范围内。

微微侧目，冷色的瞳便落在了孟晚身上。

一旁的几个服务人员都慌张极了，急忙朝着男人躬身致歉：“抱歉祝先生！这位小姐她是自己闯进来的！”

“实在抱歉！我们马上把她带走！”

“我看你们谁敢！？”孟晚恶狠狠地扫视过面前几个服务人员，声音刻薄又尖锐，“你们知不知道他是我的谁！？”

“他是我的小——”

“孟晚。”

不等孟晚开口说完，一道淡冷清冽的嗓音传来，打断了她没说完的话。

孟晚瞪大了眼睛，如同后知后觉一般，她惊慌无措地看向沙发上的男人，像是意识到自己说错了话。

“祝、祝先生……”

声音瞬间放低，孟晚微微垂头，语气软弱又恭敬。

坐在祝砚铮身旁，宋瓷微微挑眉，眼中闪过一抹得意与恶劣。

——她猜得果然没错。

祝砚铮不允许孟晚叫他“小叔”。

身后的方喻之这才急忙走了进来，一把抓住孟晚的手腕，微微蹙眉：“你跑进来做什么？不是都跟你说过了，不能随便进来！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"This lady! You can't come in!"

The service staff behind him stepped forward, hurriedly walked to Meng Wan, and stopped her.

The girl stood among the crowd, surrounded by countless service personnel, like stars over the moon.

On the leather sofa, the man has a cool and dignified temperament. He is wearing a dark gray suit and is noble and calm. He sits there upright, his eyes just falling on the girl in front of him.

The girl lifted up her skirt, revealing her beautiful white collarbone.

Her hair was in a low bun, surrounded by a few strands of hair, falling on her shoulders. Her smile was cute and gentle.

She clearly saw her.

With undisguised provocation in his eyes, he tilted his head slightly when he looked at Meng Wan, and the corners of his lips curved.

Meng Wan's eyes widened with anger on her face: "Song Ci!!"

As if frightened by the sudden sound, the provocative look in his eyes instantly turned into panic.

After frantically moving a few steps towards Zhu Yanzheng, the girl subconsciously grabbed the man's sleeve.

When Meng Wan saw this, her face became extremely ugly and her voice was sharp: "Song Ci! What on earth do you mean!?"

At first, Zhu Yanzheng's eyes were all on Song Ci.

Hearing the voice behind him, the man frowned slightly.

The girl grabbed his sleeve, and he used a little force to pull her to his side, trapping her within his safe range.

Looking sideways slightly, his cold eyes fell on Meng Wan.

Several service staff on the side were extremely panicked and hurriedly bowed to the man and apologized: "I'm sorry, Mr. Zhu! This lady broke in on her own!"

"I'm so sorry! Let's take her away right away!"

"Which one of you dares!?" Meng Wan glanced at the service staff in front of her fiercely, her voice was mean and sharp, "Do you know who he is to me!?"

"He's my little-"

"Meng Wan."

Before Meng Wan could finish her words, a cold and clear voice came, interrupting her unfinished words.

Meng Wan's eyes widened, as if she had realized it in hindsight. She looked at the man on the sofa in panic, as if she realized that she had said the wrong thing.

"Wish, wish sir..."

Her voice lowered instantly, Meng Wan lowered her head slightly, her tone was soft and respectful.

Sitting next to Zhu Yanzheng, Song Ci raised his eyebrows slightly, with a flash of pride and evil in his eyes.

——Her guess was indeed correct.

Zhu Yanzheng did not allow Meng Wan to call him "uncle".

Fang Yuzhi hurriedly walked in behind him, grabbed Meng Wan's wrist, and frowned slightly: "What are you doing running in here? Didn't I tell you not to come in casually!"
